actions.name: targeting .env files containing credentials

actions.name: exploiting CVE-2017-9841 to remotely run PHP code on websites via PHPUnit

actions.name: issuing malicious HTTP POST requests to PHPUnit eval-stdin.php URI to execute PHP code
actions.description: Websites using the PHPUnit module that have internet-accessible /vendor folders are subject to malicious HTTP POST requests to the /vendor/phpunit/phpunit/src/Util/PHP/eval-stdin.php URI which runs PHP code submitted through a POST request, allowing remote code execution.
actions.reproducibility_reason: The target host has no deployable service, so it is left out of deployment; this step is not reproduced until a service or substitute is supplied for that host.
